Shanghai Municipal Council.
October 28th 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,

The payment of repatriation money to the 36 groups
of rebels who have not yet been paid will commence this
morning at the same place. Troops and Police have received
orders to be present at 7.30 a.m.

A movement is on foot to form a Volunteer Corps
in the Chinese City but the scheme is being opposed by
Li Ping Su 李平書 and other business men. The organizers
have opened an office at the book Guild and will hold a
meeting to discuss the subject about the beginning of
next month.

All the hotels on the Nantao Bund are now being
regularly visited and searched by the Police during the
evening.

There are, so far, no signs of any serious intention
on the part of the local Chinese to support an agitation
against the French in consequence of the Tientsin incident.

Your Obedient Servant,
[签名]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
1916年10月28日
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

先生：

向尚未领款的36批叛乱分子发放遣返费的工作将于今日上午在同一地点开始。军队和警察已奉命于上午7时30分到场。

目前有人发起在华界组建志愿团的运动，但该计划正遭到李平书及其他商人的反对。组织者已在书业公会开设办事处，并将于下月初左右召开会议讨论此事。

警方现在每晚对南市外滩的所有旅馆进行例行巡查和搜查。

迄今为止，没有迹象表明当地华人因天津事件而有意支持针对法国人的煽动活动。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总探长。

警务总监上尉。
